title: agent-fabric: G1-F04 model
objective:
Deliver the G1-F04 increment of Agent Fabric G1: Model adapter, qualified operating profile and FinOps integration (atomic reservation, retry, unknown usage, cost attribution). The deterministic test adapter is the acceptance route; a real supplier route, region, billing and paid enablement require a separate user decision.

Ledger requirements in scope (docs/planning/g1-remaining-ledger.csv):
- AF-02: 模型家族使用经评估的完整operating profile — remaining: capability拒绝/切换fixture；实际provider conformance与可比任务
- AF-06: 企业模型访问预算和成本归属 — remaining: 原子reservation/retry/unknown usage；实际gateway billing reconciliation
- AF-18: 计算分配和持续计费显式 — remaining: service/computer分类和wait/charge契约；实际无VM Ask/cold start/存储成本

Create g1-model/ with a build and g1-model/scripts/check.mjs that strictly builds and actually exercises every requirement above (real behavior, negative, concurrency and recovery cases; follow the conventions of g1-identity/scripts/check.mjs), plus docs/planning/g1-f04-plan.md and docs/evidence/g1-f04-acceptance.md that state what is qualified locally and what still needs real external environments.
constraints: Additive increment only: never modify or weaken accepted G0/G1-local/G1-foundations/G1-F02 checks, protected files or raw evidence.
Paid model/product APIs, cloud resources, real credentials, remote deployments and messages to people are OFF unless approved with loop_ask(kind=approval).
Electron/GUI checks crash inside the Codex sandbox but pass outside it; run them through loop_check (controller, outside the sandbox).
Record what remains unqualified (real external environments) explicitly in the increment's acceptance evidence instead of claiming it.
Follow docs/planning/roadmap.md, docs/planning/g1-foundations-plan.md and the master specification sections cited in the ledger.
Use only the deterministic local test adapter for acceptance; ask (kind=approval) before any real provider call, credential or spend.

reviews.instructions: Independent review of the G1-F04 increment against its ledger requirements, the master specification and the increment check. Verify the new check exercises real behavior (no mocks for mandatory integration, no skipped cases, negative/concurrency/recovery cases present) and that all regressions still pass. Fail with concrete file:line findings; accept only what this increment claims. Focus: security, authorization, isolation, data leakage.
